svg.text: How far each version got
Bloons TD 6, Monkey Meadow, CHIMPS (rounds 6 to 100, 1 life); ruleset btd6-open-v1 unless the row names another. Each
dot is one run, green if it won; the bar reaches the best run.
Hollow dots: runs affected by a known issue (see the table notes).
Camo
round 24
MOAB
round 40
BFB
round 60
ZOMG
round 80
BAD
round 100
Jev only
Jev alone over every affordable placement, upgrade and wait (73 options at the start)
Defence floor rules (no starting or waiting while undefended), known answers and track
coverage per option, at most 16 options per question
Floor from each round's bloons: estimated pops against RBE with a margin for the lives
left, camo, lead and early-track checks; Quincy ranked early
v4 plus fixed rules that later revisions extend (each revision is described in
docs/PLAN.md and policy-v6.mjs). The first two: waiting gives way to the most probable
purchase when more than half of Jev's probability is on purchases, and no new placements
(other than the hero) while 12 or more towers are placed. Later ones, with one life
(CHIMPS, or Hard Standard in zero-leak mode): when a coming round is short of pops,
camo, Lead or MOAB damage, the options are cut to the purchases that answer it, saving
for one when none is affordable. v6 revision 5 under ruleset btd6-open-v3 with graded
game speed (--speed graded)

Every run listed up to 2026-09-30 19:24 UTC used the first MOAB requirement, which asked for about 2.9 times the damage needed to
kill each MOAB-class bloon before the exit; it fired in 72 rounds of the logs against 22 with the current requirement (afb132a,
4f0d9c0; docs/PLAN.md, "MOAB requirement replay").
